## What does this PR do?

- [ ] Adds a new resource
- [ ] Updates an existing entry (fixes a link, corrects a description)
- [ ] Removes an abandoned or duplicate resource
- [ ] Adds a new section

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing entries to avoid duplicates.
- [ ] This PR contains a single suggestion (one resource, one section, or one fix).
- [ ] The entry follows the format: `- [Resource Name](url) - Description ending with a period.`
- [ ] The description explains **why** the resource matters, not just what it is.
- [ ] The entry is placed in alphabetical order within its section, where possible.
- [ ] I checked that the link works and points to the correct page.
- [ ] If this adds a new section, I opened an issue first to discuss scope.
